$comment: Conformance cases for command mode route-follower, rule pure-pursuit-v1 (scenario-parameters.schema.json, $defs.follower), with the walk-corner values: forward 0.5 m/s, sideways 0, lookahead 0.75 m and max_turn_rate 1.0 rad/s. yaw_deg is the base yaw in degrees, counterclockwise from +x; a consumer converts it to radians as yaw_deg × π ÷ 180. command is [forward m/s, sideways m/s, turn_rate rad/s]. A command written as 0 must be exactly 0: on a straight route with the base on it and facing along it the follower sends exactly the constant command, so hallway evidence would not change. Other values must match within tolerance, because atan2 and sin can differ in the last bit between JavaScript and Python. tooling/world-layout.mjs followRoute and the Python package follow_route both have to pass them.

steps.name: on the route at spawn-entrance, facing along it: exactly the constant command
on the route in the middle, facing along it
on the first leg at spawn-entrance, facing along it: exactly the constant command
left of the first leg: turns right, back towards the route
approaching the corner: the lookahead point is on the second leg, so it turns left
at the turn point, still facing +x: clamped to max_turn_rate
on the first leg facing +y: clamped to -max_turn_rate
right of the second leg, facing +y: turns left, back towards the route
past the exit: the lookahead continues along the last leg, so no turn
